sources.title: 大模型时代的多语言研究综述

cases.question: 用中文概括这篇论文的核心架构变化、两项主要机器翻译结果和结论适用范围，控制在 200 字内，并标明相关章节。
cases.rubric: Transformer/self-attention; 28.4 and 41.8 BLEU; restrict conclusion to reported tasks.

cases.question: 解释式(1)中为什么除以 sqrt(d_k)，而不是直接除以 d_k。若 d_k=64，缩放分母是多少？请用公式和原文证据回答，不超过 160 字。
cases.rubric: Denominator 8; variance grows with d_k; mitigate softmax saturation/small gradients; cite C1.

cases.question: 仅看表2的 WMT14 英德 BLEU，Transformer big 比 base 高多少分？同时给出二者原值和证据引用，控制在 100 字内。
cases.rubric: big 28.4; base 27.3; absolute difference 1.1 BLEU, not percentage points.

cases.question: 那相对提升百分比是多少？该表给出了这个差异的 95% 置信区间吗？区分自行计算与原文报告，控制在 140 字内。
cases.rubric: Computed relative improvement about 4.03%; no 95% CI in supplied table; cite current evidence.

cases.question: 用不超过 250 字概括这篇综述的研究对象、前沿方向和主要挑战，区分综述归纳与作者提出的新模型，并标明相关章节。
cases.rubric: Survey, not a new model; multilingual training/alignment/extension; fairness/safety, curse and training cost.

cases.question: ROOTS 的 59 种语言是否全是自然语言？请区分具体类别，并解释为什么不能把 59 直接用作自然语言覆盖数。必须引用证据，不超过 120 字。
cases.rubric: 46 natural plus 13 programming; 59 includes both categories; cite C1 (printed p66).

cases.question: 按 Aya、Bactrain-X 的顺序比较二者指令数据的构造方式及质量限制；论文是否以统一实验直接证明一个全面优于另一个？必须引用证据，不超过 200 字。
cases.rubric: Aya human contribution/filtering; Bactrain-X translation plus gpt-3.5-turbo answers and low-resource noise; no unified superiority experiment.

cases.question: 刚才后者的 6 万 7 千条是每种语言还是所有语言合计？据文中语言数估算总量，并说明这个估算能否单独证明它比前者质量更高。引用证据，不超过 160 字。
cases.rubric: Bactrain-X has 67k per language across 51, estimated 3,417,000; quantity cannot prove quality over Aya.

notes: 原自动检查为保守提示；逐条复核，舍入 4.0% / 342 万及译成等同义表述均可接受。

reviewNote: All 56 final answers inspected by Codex against the selected source pages. This is an exploratory two-paper evaluation, not independent blind grading. Nine initial regex review flags are equivalent wording/rounding. Scripts now accept those forms; no paid rerun was made.
limitations: Two computer-science papers, one sample per question per model, no statistical ranking.
Curated evidence pages and extracted full text; does not evaluate production retrieval, MathPix, browser or database.
No multi-domain or million-token stress test; provider token counts/prices are not directly interchangeable.
